### Venture Global Commences Commercial Operations of Phase One of Plaquemines LNG


November 1, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/622838971/files/doc_news/Venture-Global-Commences-Commercial-Operations-of-Phase-One-of-Plaquemines-LNG-2026.pdf)


- *COD declared just over 53 months from FID on Phase One*
- *First long-term sales and purchase agreement (SPA) cargo lifted by Shell*


ARLINGTON, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


On October 31, 2026, Venture Global (NYSE: VG) commenced commercial operations of the first phase of its second LNG export project – Plaquemines LNG – and the sale of low-cost, U.S. LNG to the first phase’s long-term customers. The commercial operations date (COD) for Phase 1 of Plaquemines LNG was reached in just over 53 months from the final investment decision on the project, making it among the fastest greenfield LNG projects ever completed.


“Achieving commercial operations at the first phase of our second LNG project in 53 months is a testament to our team's relentless dedication and hard work,” said **Venture Global CEO Mike Sabel.** “We are thrilled to hit another major milestone that enables us to continue delivering reliable, affordable American LNG to the global market. We deeply appreciate the collaboration of our regulators and supply chain partners, whose shared commitment helped us deliver this project safely and on schedule.”


The first post-COD cargo from Plaquemines Phase 1 departed today at 3:26 AM and was lifted by Shell. Venture Global looks forward to working with its long-term customers to deliver reliable and affordable US LNG supply for decades to come. These low-cost volumes will act as an important stabilizing force as the global LNG market endures an extended period of volatility.


**About Venture Global**


Venture Global is an American producer and exporter of low-cost U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) with over 100 MTPA of capacity in production, construction, or development. Venture Global began producing LNG from its first facility in 2022 and is now one of the largest LNG exporters in the United States. The company’s vertically integrated business includes assets across the LNG supply chain including LNG production, natural gas transport, shipping and regasification. The company’s first three projects, Calcasieu Pass, Plaquemines LNG, and CP2 LNG, are located in Louisiana along the Gulf of America. Venture Global is developing carbon capture and sequestration projects at each of its LNG facilities.
